16.t: Working with data: power station efficiency
q: Which power station is the most efficient?
Calculate the energy wasted by an old coal station for each 100 MJ of fuel, and say where it goes.
100 − 33 = 67 MJ, mostly as heat to the cooling towers and air.
Explain why combined cycle gas stations are more efficient than coal.
They use the hot exhaust from the gas turbine to make steam that drives a second turbine, so less heat is wasted.
